title: Generate a typed ngu-form component from a JSON Schema or an OpenAPI document

name.description: Name of the form, such as "signup".

schema.description: Path of a JSON Schema or OpenAPI 3 document (JSON), relative to the workspace.
schema.x-prompt: Path of the JSON Schema or OpenAPI document?

pointer.description: JSON pointer to the object schema, such as "#/components/schemas/Signup". Defaults to the document itself.

operation.description: OpenAPI operationId, or "post /users", whose JSON request body the form edits.

model.description: Name of the generated interface. Defaults to the schema's name, else the form name.

path.description: Folder for the component. Defaults to src/app/<name>-form.
